Served as the ﬁrst tester for the Data Science & MLOps track, solving challenges using only the supplied
briefs and resources to check that learners had everything they needed.
Independently completed four week-long projects covering data pipelines (Dagster, pandas, uv, Docker,
S3-compatible storage), supervised learning (scikit-learn and logistic regression from scratch in NumPy),
XGBoost demand forecasting with time-series features, and production MLOps (MLﬂow, LakeFS, FastAPI).
Logged task times, approaches, blockers and learning outcomes daily to assess whether projects ﬁt their
timeframe. Documented bugs, gaps and ambiguities using the internal testing framework and delivered a
report with recommendations for all four projects.
Coordinated feedback between the test lead, curriculum designers, partner-company delegates and university
faculty through regular meetings. Contributed to a web app for a company presentation.

Migrated container images from JFrog to Azure Container Registry (ACR) across dev, global-dev, test and
global-test. Conﬁgured local and CI/CD Skaffold workﬂows, created service connections, restricted each
registry to its matching AKS cluster, removed obsolete dependencies and updated documentation.
Resolved AKS node memory overcommitment by setting resource requests and limits in service templates
and overrides. Added monitoring for pods stuck in waiting states.
Developed Terraform modules, automated PostgreSQL schema and search-path setup for Kuberpult, added
deployment checks for missing MongoDB connection strings, and simpliﬁed shell-script execution.
Updated Azure DevOps pipelines for ACR authentication, image pushes and triggers when ﬁles move
between components. Cached Buf modules in the CI Docker image to reduce downloads and build time, and
disabled a resource-intensive Go lint step on main.
Implemented span-level MongoDB tracing with Datadog’s dd-trace-go, delayed restarts to capture
failed-migration logs, and ﬁxed a MongoDB Docker health check.
Prevented secrets from appearing in Terraform error logs by passing sensitive PostgreSQL values through
environment variables. Fixed and tested Azure Key Vault secret creation when Oracle account setup failed.
Forked the go-debug-helper Docker image, updated Delve for newer Go versions, integrated it with Skaffold,
and conﬁgured Renovate for updates.

Tutor, Advanced Practical Lab in Computer Networking (iLab)

Projects
ML-MLOps · Dagster, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, MLﬂow, LakeFS, FastAPI, Docker, uv
Built four projects spanning the ML lifecycle for bike-share demand. Created a Dagster pipeline with swappable
local and S3 storage, implemented logistic regression in scikit-learn and from scratch in NumPy, and used
cyclical and lag features for XGBoost forecasting (test R2 of about 0.96, RMSE of about 45.5). Added MLﬂow
tracking and model registration, LakeFS data versioning, alias-based promotion, a FastAPI endpoint and a
Dagster sensor that triggers retraining on data changes.
MediaSleuth360 · Python, Streamlit, Whisper, Llama 3, Gemini, ffmpeg
Built a multilingual audio and video analysis app with timestamped transcripts, automatic subtitles, structured
summaries, a chatbot for querying and navigating media, and caching for repeat uploads. Used Whisper
large-v3 and Llama 3 via the Groq API, plus Gemini 1.5 Flash.
WebBoost · Python, Flask, Playwright, BeautifulSoup, NLTK, Vercel
Built a blog analysis tool in a six-person team and deployed it on Vercel. It assigns weighted scores for content,
UX, SEO, social integration and ad intrusiveness, applies ﬁve readability indices (Flesch, Fog, SMOG,
Coleman-Liau and ARI), and prioritises recommendations. The team won its TOMFoolery challenge.
Checkers-AI · Python, Pygame
Built American checkers with Minimax (alpha-beta pruning) and a Q-learning agent trained against Minimax.
Supports mandatory captures, multi-jumps, king promotion and draw detection.
Raycasting-in-Maze · C++, SDL2, CMake
Built a real-time 3D ﬁrst-person maze game with DDA wall intersections, procedural maze generation,
conﬁgurable ﬁeld of view, movement speed and resolution, and automated build scripts.
Fylio · JavaScript, CSS, Chrome Extension (Manifest V3)
Built a Chrome extension that replaces Chromium’s local directory listings with a Finder-style interface, including
grid and list views, breadcrumb navigation, sorting, light and dark themes, and colour-coded ﬁle types.
